meta.name: saga-orchestration
meta.description: Implement saga patterns for distributed transactions and cross-aggregate workflows. Use this skill when implementing distributed transactions across microservices where 2PC is unavailable, designing compensating actions for failed order workflows that span inventory, payment, and shipping services, building event-driven saga coordinators for travel booking systems that must roll back hotel, flight, and car rental reservations atomically, or debugging stuck saga states in production where compensation steps never complete.

copy.tagline: 让跨系统操作在失败时自动撤销
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的操作牵动多个系统,一步失败就要全部回退。
copy.tagline_en: Roll back failed steps across multiple systems to keep data consistent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your operation spans multiple systems and needs full rollback when any part fails

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按你给的服务边界、失败模式与 SLA,产出带顺序步骤和补偿命令的 saga 定义、编排式或协同式实现代码、每步超时配置,以及卡死侦测与死信队列恢复的监控设置。
howto.when: 当你在微服务间实现分布式事务但没有 2PC、为跨库存/支付/物流的失败订单设计补偿动作,或调试卡在生产环境补偿步骤的 saga 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把下单流程做成 saga,列出每步和对应的补偿命令
say.note: 产出带顺序步骤与补偿命令的 saga 定义

say.text: 这个 saga 卡在 COMPENSATING 状态了,怎么排查
say.note: 排查补偿处理未发布完成事件的原因

say.text: 给 create_shipment 单独配 15 分钟超时,别用全局超时
say.note: 按步骤类型配置超时,避免误触发补偿

howto.what_en: Given service boundaries, failure modes and SLAs, Claude produces saga definitions with ordered steps and compensation commands, orchestrator or choreography code, per-step timeouts, and stuck-saga monitoring with DLQ recovery.
howto.when_en: Use when you need multi-service transactions without 2PC, compensating actions for failed order workflows, or debugging stuck saga states in production.

say_en.text: Turn our order flow into a saga and list each step with its compensation command
say_en.note: Yields a saga definition with steps and compensations

say_en.text: This saga is stuck in COMPENSATING - how do I debug it?
say_en.note: Traces why compensation never publishes completion

say_en.text: Set a 15-minute timeout for create_shipment instead of a global one
say_en.note: Configures per-step timeouts to avoid false compensation
